messages.text:
Your wireless mouse is eligible for a refund. The shop's records show it was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). The refund would be 69.90 BRL, which is what you paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount).

To go ahead, please confirm with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count as confirmation. A staff member then has to approve the request before anything is paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).

messages.text: Does the refund go back to my card or to store credit?

The refund is recorded against the order's original payment (payment d41-o1-p1), and the policy doesn't offer store credit. A refund can only go to the original payment, never to another account or card (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It isn't a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear (refund-policy/v2/payout). Your card's issuer handles the credit itself (refund-policy/v2/payment).
